snippet.title: DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round × THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV Collaboration Trailer
snippet.description:
Preorders now available: https://teamninja-studio.com/doa6/lastround/us/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=evojapan2026&utm_id=Caption

Mai Shiranui and Kula Diamond from the highly popular SNK fighting game THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV, will be joining the cast of DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round as collaborative DLCs alongside the newly enhanced stage, LOST PARADISE "OBORO". 

DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round and DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round Core Fighters are scheduled to release June 25, 2026 on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and Windows PC via Steam®.
